title: Chimeric music reveals an interaction of pitch and time in electrophysiological signatures of music encoding
description: EEG recordings from 27 normal-hearing adults listening to original monophonic music and 'chimeric' music, in which the pitch contours and note onset times of two melodies are exchanged. This distorts musical pattern while preserving the marginal pitch and timing statistics. The dataset supports investigation of pitch-time interactions in the electrophysiological encoding of music. It includes a click-train phase and a music phase with 33 trials per stimulus type.
methods_description: Participants sat in a sound-isolating booth and heard stimuli through ER-2 insert earphones at about 60 dB SPL. Phase one presented ten one-minute click trials. Phase two presented 33 shuffled trials each of original and chimeric monophonic music, with 0.5 s pauses between trials. EEG was recorded in BrainVision format. Stimuli were controlled with a Python script using expyfun. Participants also completed a musicianship questionnaire.
